name: dropin
title: Dropin
description: Search for any place and drop its map link straight into whatever you're typing in — iMessage, Slack, WhatsApp, email. Never leave the conversation to look up an address.
author: gmoney

commands.name: send-place
commands.title: Send a Place
commands.subtitle: Dropin
commands.description: Search for a place and paste its map link into the app you were just typing in.

preferences.name: provider
preferences.title: Map Links
preferences.description: Which map service your shared links should point to. Apple Maps links render as a rich map bubble inside iMessage; Google Maps links work identically on every platform.

preferences.name: outputFormat
preferences.title: What to Send
preferences.description: Heads up: iMessage only renders the big map preview when the message contains nothing but the link. Adding the place name turns it into a plain blue link.

data.title: Just the link (renders a map preview)
Name, then link on a new line

preferences.name: bias
preferences.title: Search Near
preferences.description: Optional. Coordinates as "lat,lon" to bias results toward your area, so "switchyards" finds the one down the street instead of one across the world. Grab a pair from any map URL.

preferences.name: geocoder
preferences.title: Geocoder Endpoint
preferences.description: Optional. Defaults to the public Photon instance, which needs no API key. Point this at your own Photon server if you search heavily.
